Spartan (2004) 300 (2006) Rise of an Empire (2014) The Last Spartan: Thermopylae 480 BC (2007) The Spartans (1975) The Battle of Thermopylae (1977) The Spartan Way (2011) The Spartan King (2009) The Spartan Legacy (2013) The 300 Spartans (1962) Sparta, the legendary city-state of ancient Greece, has captured the imagination of filmmakers and audiences alike with its tales of valor, discipline, and epic battles. This curated list of the best historical films about Sparta not only brings to life the legendary warriors and their society but also offers a glimpse into the historical events that shaped this iconic civilization. From epic battles to the daily life of Spartans, these films provide a rich tapestry of history, drama, and heroism, making them a must-watch for anyone fascinated by ancient history or simply looking for a thrilling cinematic experience.
TRAILER ▶ Spartan (2004) Description:
While not directly about ancient Sparta, this modern thriller uses the term "Spartan" to symbolize the tough, disciplined nature of its protagonist, reflecting the Spartan ethos in a contemporary setting. Fact:
The film was written and directed by David Mamet, known for his sharp dialogue and complex characters.

TRAILER ▶ 300 (2006) Description:
This film, based on Frank Miller's graphic novel, dramatizes the Battle of Thermopylae where King Leonidas and his 300 Spartans hold off the Persian army. Its stylized visuals and intense action sequences make it a standout depiction of Spartan bravery. Fact:
The film was shot almost entirely on a green screen, with the background and effects added in post-production. Also, Gerard Butler, who played King Leonidas, did most of his own stunts.

TRAILER ▶ Rise of an Empire (2014) Description:
A sequel to "300," this film explores the naval Battle of Artemisium and the rise of Themistocles, offering a different perspective on the Persian invasion and the role of Sparta in the larger Greek resistance. Fact:
Eva Green's performance as Artemisia was widely praised, and she performed many of her own stunts, including sword fighting.

This film delves into the life and culture of Sparta, exploring their military training, societal structure, and the famous battle of Thermopylae from a different angle. Fact:

A documentary that explores the daily life, training, and philosophy of the Spartans, offering insights into what made them such formidable warriors. Fact:

This film focuses on the life of King Leonidas before the Battle of Thermopylae, exploring his rise to power and the challenges he faced in leading Sparta. Fact:

This documentary examines the lasting impact of Spartan culture on Western civilization, from their military tactics to their societal structure. Fact:

TRAILER ▶ The 300 Spartans (1962) Description:
This earlier adaptation of the Battle of Thermopylae focuses on the historical accuracy of the event, providing a more grounded portrayal of the Spartan defense against the Persians. Fact:
